mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS category_id, c.name AS category_name, c.display_order AS category_display_order, sc.id AS sub_category_id, sc.name AS sub_category_name, sc.display_order AS sub_category_display_order FROM categories c LEFT JOIN sub_categories sc ON c.id = sc.category_id AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM spots s WHERE s.sub_category_id = sc.id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL ) ORDER BY c.display_order ASC NULLS LAST, sc.display_order ASC NULLS LAST

SELECT c.id AS category_id, c.name AS category_name, c.display_order AS category_display_order, c.is_default AS category_is_default, sc.id AS sub_category_id, sc.name AS sub_category_name, sc.display_order AS sub_category_display_order, sc.is_default AS sub_category_is_default FROM categories c LEFT JOIN sub_categories sc ON c.id = sc.category_id ORDER BY c.display_order ASC NULLS LAST, sc.display_order ASC NULLS LAST
SELECT id, name FROM categories WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT c.id, c.name, c.display_order FROM categories c ORDER BY c.display_order ASC NULLS LAST

SELECT id, name, display_order, is_default FROM categories WHERE display_order >= (SELECT display_order FROM categories WHERE id = #{id}) AND is_default = false ORDER BY display_order ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, name, display_order, is_default FROM categories WHERE display_order <= (SELECT display_order FROM categories WHERE id = #{id}) AND is_default = false ORDER BY display_order DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id, name, display_order, is_default FROM categories WHERE is_default = false ORDER BY display_order ASC NULLS LAST
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO categories (name, display_order) VALUES (#{name}, (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(display_order), 0) + 1 FROM categories))
